rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Mohana ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, before 2006).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 2006 as 'Mohana'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Very large, borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form.
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower or exhibition.
